newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on interbank and retail interest, dealers said on Monday.

"The interbank rate fell quite a bit today but there was little impact from the market. Treasury bill yields were slightly higher but bond prices were slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.66/1.61 percent compared with last Friday's yield of 1.43/1.38 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.62/1.57 percent against 1.36/1.31 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$99.30/99.35 from last Friday's close of S$99.41/99.46 and June 2003 at S$99.31/99.36 versus S$99.46/99.51.
The overnight interbank offered rate fell to 2-7/8 2-3/4 percent against last Friday's 3-3/4 3-5/8 percent.
